{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool coat, structured cut, knee-length, charcoal gray, brushed wool with a cashmere blend.
Tweed blazer, single-breasted cut, hip-length, forest green, virgin wool.
Pleated silk blouse, relaxed fit, cropped length, ivory, lightweight woven silk.
Straight-leg dark denim jeans, medium wash, ankle length, indigo, rigid cotton twill.
Leather loafers, pointed toe, mid-calf height, black, smooth calfskin with a slight sheen.

This outfit honors the request for "neat" formality while adapting to the frosty, snowy autumn morning by including an outer coat for warmth and protection against road salt. The textured tweed blazer paired with a crisp silk blouse creates a polished, professional look suitable for an office environment without sacrificing comfort during a twenty-minute walk. The deep forest green of the blazer adds a touch of seasonal elegance that complements the neutral tones of the denim and coat, ensuring the wearer feels both stylish and prepared for the cold weather."}
